gen-dafont-capture-it-fs-chillax: Tall, tight and nearly sealed, Capture It stands over Chillax, whose loose, looping strokes leave every curve a little unfinished and easygoing. Sans text like that stays relaxed for pages.
gen-dafont-capture-it-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans opens its curves wide and draws every stroke at identical weight, which gives Capture It's towering, nearly sealed letters plenty of room to loom over it. Plain sans meets urban muscle.
gen-dafont-capture-it-outfit: Commanding yet urban, Capture It rises on a towering x-height with hardly any gaps, while Outfit bends its curves like cable and leaves them open. Sans lines like these stay easy going down a page.
gen-dafont-capture-it-plus-jakarta-sans: Capture It towers in nearly sealed, uniform letters with barely a gap anywhere, a strong contrast to what follows. Plus Jakarta Sans keeps its monoline curves well apart, so shrinking the heading would squander its height.
gen-dafont-capture-it-roboto-slab: Tall, tightly shut and urban, Capture It looms over the page. And Roboto Slab, with its open throats and a dominant middle zone, gives that block of closed letters something structured to lean on.
gen-dafont-capture-it-sora: Barely any openings and a towering x-height make Capture It feel almost sealed shut. Sora keeps its c and s widely parted and its curves free of swelling, so the two read as lock and key.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-amulya: Amulya reads modern and generous, its curve gaps kept wide. Capture Smallz, with its big-bodied lowercase, earns its keep when set large and brief, a raw, tactical shout above that open sans.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-chillax: Chillax draws its line like loose spaghetti, with pen-lifted curves left unfinished, while Capture Smallz above it is raw, tactical and chunky in the lowercase. Next to each other they feel like a shout and a shrug.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-plein: Capture Smallz brings raw, tactical lowercase with a big body, rounded out by something quieter below. Plein is a reliable plain sans, giving each round letter a clear channel in, so long paragraphs go down smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-fs-spline-sans: Big-bodied lowercase gives Capture Smallz a raw, tactical bulk that you notice before anything else. And Spline Sans answers with wide curve gaps and uniform strokes, which feels approachable beside that heavy, cut-vinyl look.
